newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Globe to raise 6.06 bln pesos in new equity.
newsitem.headline: Globe to raise 6.06 bln pesos in new equity.

text.p: Globe Telecom is planning to raise 6.06 billion pesos in new capital to finance its fixed telephone line and cellular phone projects, the National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) said on Monday.
NTC head Simeon Kintanar told reporters that the new equity will come from Globe shareholders Ayala Corp and Singapore Telecommunications Ltd.
Kintanar said Globe president Delfin Lazaro wrote to him saying the board will discuss details of the equity infusion at its meeting on July 29.
It may also issue warrants, he said. No details of which were not yet available.
As a cellular phone company and an international gateway facility operator, Globe is required to install 700,000 fixed telephone lines.
